description: Scrub through any video and capture any frame as a PNG image.

faqs.a: The frame is drawn from the video element to a canvas at the video's native resolution, then exported as a PNG — no quality is lost in the capture step.
faqs.q: What quality is the captured frame?

faqs.a: Some browsers restrict seeking precision, landing on the nearest keyframe. Scrub slowly for the most accurate positioning.
faqs.q: Why does the scrubber sometimes jump slightly?

faqs.a: No. Your video is loaded locally in your browser and never uploaded anywhere.

howto: Choose a video file from your device.
Play it or drag the scrubber to the exact frame you want.
Preview the PNG below and click "Download PNG" to save it.
title: Video Frame Extractor
